name: standmeet-summarize-mcp
description: summarize block (JS, cross-platform — replaces the former Go binary): a stdio-MCP server whose summarize_conversation tool owns the report prompt + assembly and reaches the host over STANDMEET_HOST_SOCKET (conversation.read / inference.generate / report.store). Owns no data. As JS it cannot import host/Go internals — host-blindness is structural.
